Prompt Deck v1.1

Design refresh
New in v1.1
  • Apple-inspired design refresh: floating output dock, squared-off chips with soft-tint selection, instant press feedback, refined typography
  • Soft scroll edges on the toolbar & dock, richer glass materials
  • Full reduced-motion, reduced-transparency and high-contrast support
  • New Vitpepper white balance & burnt-paper Paper theme
What's inside
  • Full cinematography keyword library with conflict engine & blocks output
  • Presets with thumbnails, editing, single-item share (export/import)
  • Prompt Archive for reusable full-text prompts
  • Lighting diagrams & camera/lens effect tooltips on hover
  • Film stock visual compare
  • AI Scene Assistant (bring your own API key)
  • Prompt history, undo, trash with restore, 3 themes, installable app (PWA)
Coming next
  • 🎬 Video Mode — Seedance prompt support with motion & multishot keywords
  • ☁ Cloud sync — automatic backup, no more manual exports
